newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli stabbed 20 times guarding West Bank Jews.
newsitem.headline: Israeli stabbed 20 times guarding West Bank Jews.

text.p: An Israeli guarding a Jewish settlement was stabbed 20 times and wounded seriously early on Tuesday near the West Bank town of Hebron in an apparent Palestinian guerrilla attack, military sources said.
The attack occurred at Omarim settlement south of Hebron, a volatile town split between Israeli and Palestinian rule. The man was rushed to a hospital in Beersheba, southern Israel.
ISRAELI MILITARY CENSORS ORDERED DELETIONS IN THIS REPORT

"We found him stabbed all over his body, about 20 stabs mainly in the head, chest and stomach -- penetrating stabs," said paramedic Gadi Abuhatzeira. He described the guard's condition as "very serious".
Soldiers launched a search for the assailants. Witnesses saw two knives, a mask and a cap at the site.

"The guard was attacked by two stabbers who apparently surprised him. It was in the darkness, a little after four in the morning and what's clear is that the evidence indicates he fought with them," said Jewish settler leader Ron Schechner.

Near Hebron on Monday, at least 10 Palestinians were injured by Israeli soldiers who used clubs and guns to beat back about 100 Arabs trying to stop workers from opening a road for Jewish settlers near the West Bank town of Hebron, witnesses said.

The clash was the first serious outbreak of Israeli-Arab violence since Palestinian President Yasser Arafat spurned an Israeli decision on Friday to hand over another nine percent of the West Bank to Palestine Liberation Organisation rule.

Palestinians wanted 30 percent and a say in determining the scope of this and two other pullbacks from mainly rural areas of the West Bank which Israel-PLO interim peace deals mandate must be completed by mid-1998.
